verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a transactional messaging platform, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is the Scheduled Messages API, which covers one-off scheduled sends, not recurring schedules or workflows. This is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Keep track of scheduled messages using MailerSend's Scheduled Messages API endpoint.
